paragraphs: He is mentioned in a baraita in Eruvin 95a; he disagrees with R' Natan.[^1]

notes.text: The baraita places Yonatan in disagreement with Natan. צה. gives Eruvin 95a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. The heading supplies no title; Natan’s abbreviated title remains R'.
